title: Bot data-mirror merges restart the live trader: comms/desk, comms/live_review and other comms/* data paths are outside the deploy's non-runtime set, so 19 of 21 trader restarts on 11-04 followed one
note: Found by lane WORK-STORE-DESIGN (session_01AFoLuKFYUoKzs5TXjGfEdh), docs/plans/WORK-STORE-DESIGN-2026-11.md section 5. MEASURED: the 21 'Started ICT Trader Live' times on 2026-11-04 00:00-18:18Z (SYSTEM-AUDIT-INTEGRATION F9, complete journalctl scan) vs main merges in the same window (git log --format=%ct, UTC): every restart is 1-7 min after a merge touching a path outside NON_RUNTIME_PATHS_RE; for 19 of 21 every such merge was a bot data write only (desk mirror, live-review mirror, forecast-grade, closed-trade grades, live-parity, compute-util-telemetry); the other 2 were also bot or research writes, not human code: 03:19 a bot rewrite of config/economic_calendar.yaml, 01:01 a comms/prop_survival evidence record; no restart that day followed a human code merge. CODE: scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh RUNTIME_CHANGES grep -vE list and scripts/ops/trader_import_closure.py NON_RUNTIME_PATHS_RE (rule b: a non-.py path outside the set restarts the trader) omit comms/desk/, comms/live_review/, comms/claude_strategy_scores.jsonl, comms/live_parity/, comms/cloud/, comms/news_alpha/, comms/strategy_reviews/, comms/reports/. 7-day census 10-28..11-04: 573 of 1,660 main commits are runtime-class; 397 of them are these mirrors. Each restart costs a boot (~12 s) plus warm-up; 17:01Z landed a minute after an hourly bar close. FIX (Tier 2, deploy path): first confirm each of those trees is read from disk at use time and never cached at import by a long-running unit (src readers: desk_event_trigger, desk_packet_wake, live_review_rows*, live_review_due, short_hold_wake, ltr_first_proof, insights/data_sources, order_packages, evidence_horizon, strategy_review, gpu_spend, reports routers), then add the safe ones to the three lockstep lists (deploy_pull_restart.sh, trader_import_closure.py, diag._NON_RUNTIME_PATHS_RE; tests/test_diag_restart_pending_lockstep.py and tests/test_deploy_pull_restart_runtime_gate.py). Not a gate. Superseded in the long run by WORK-STORE-DESIGN moving these flows off the repo, but it is a one-PR fix now and should not wait for that. CLOSES WHEN: a day of journalctl shows no trader restart within 7 min of a data-only merge.
